descriptor.scene: There is no human being in this picture and no second capped mascot figure. The picture has TWO parts. SMALL, at the LOWER LEFT edge of the frame and taking up no more than a quarter of it, the manager stands newly awake on his low wooden platform inside his glowing machine, square and front-on, calm and attentive, mitten arms relaxed at his sides, his plum light only just come up around him. FILLING THE REST OF THE FRAME, one large soft-edged painted cloud of warm cream light holds the craft that arrives with him, painted as its own little warm scene in the same ink-and-wash as the rest of the book: an open picture book lying flat with its pages caught mid-turn, a second book standing open on its covers beside it, and a small empty child's chair drawn up to them in warm lamplight. The cloud's edge is a soft feathered border of the same paint, never a drawn outline, never a comic balloon, no tail, no border line, no vignette ring. No lettering and no readable marks on any page. Warm plum light at the manager's corner, cream-gold light inside the cloud.
descriptor._caption: He wakes up already knowing his trade. The craft arrives with him the moment he does: how a story breathes, where a page should turn, what a five-year-old can carry. Nobody teaches him on the job. The job is in him when he opens his eyes.
negatives: a drawn outline, ink border, comic balloon tail, panel frame or vignette ring around the cloud
readable text or lettering on the books
